name: HDFS 5342
title: Parenting, Parenthood, and Family Science Interventions
description: Parents’ roles, identities, and behavior and the dynamics of parenthood across the lifespan. Interpersonal, familial, and societal roles of parents and the interventions that support individual parent and family well-being outcomes are presented.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in Human Development and Family Sciences, others with instructor consent.
